# Infinite Red — account brief

## Who

Infinite Red is a consultancy specializing in React Native app design and development ([source](https://infinitered.com/)). Its GitHub org profile lists the site infinitered.com ([source](https://github.com/infinitered)).

## Production Expo signals

- `eas.json` is present in infinitered/ignite ([source](https://github.com/infinitered/ignite/blob/main/eas.json)).
- infinitered/ignite pins react-native 0.74.5 in package.json ([source](https://github.com/infinitered/ignite/blob/main/package.json)).
- infinitered/ignite has CI workflows checked in ([source](https://github.com/infinitered/ignite/tree/main/.github/workflows)).
- The org has 150 public repos and 2100 followers ([source](https://github.com/infinitered)).
- infinitered/ignite last pushed 2026-08-11 ([source](https://github.com/infinitered/ignite)).

## Who to talk to

- Maintainer One (@infinitered-maintainer-1), top contributor to infinitered/ignite with 310 commits ([source](https://github.com/infinitered-maintainer-1)). Profile lists company "Infinite Red" and website https://infinitered.com ([source](https://github.com/infinitered-maintainer-1)).
- Maintainer Two (@infinitered-maintainer-2), top contributor to infinitered/ignite with 188 commits ([source](https://github.com/infinitered-maintainer-2)). Profile lists company "Infinite Red" and website https://infinitered.com ([source](https://github.com/infinitered-maintainer-2)).
- Maintainer Three (@infinitered-maintainer-3), top contributor to infinitered/ignite with 97 commits ([source](https://github.com/infinitered-maintainer-3)). Profile lists company "Infinite Red" and website https://infinitered.com ([source](https://github.com/infinitered-maintainer-3)).

## Why now

infinitered/ignite last pushed 2026-08-11 ([source](https://github.com/infinitered/ignite)) and tracks react-native 0.74.5 ([source](https://github.com/infinitered/ignite/blob/main/package.json)). The evidence does not include app store update cadence or review volume, so recency here is repo activity only.

## Suggested opener

Maintainer One, you have 310 commits to infinitered/ignite, the most of any contributor ([source](https://github.com/infinitered-maintainer-1)). The repo carries both an `eas.json` ([source](https://github.com/infinitered/ignite/blob/main/eas.json)) and CI workflows under `.github/workflows` ([source](https://github.com/infinitered/ignite/tree/main/.github/workflows)). Where does the split fall between those workflows and EAS when a client project builds off the template?
